CDM Project Design Document Form
Title of the project activity: Nyota Small Hydro Project
Host Party: Uganda
Project participants: Nyota Hydro Ltd.
Applied methodology: ACM0002 Version 20.0

1.1 General description of project activity
The project activity is a run-of-river hydro facility connected to the national grid.

1.2 Project location
The project is located in Kasese District, Uganda.
